snippet: An extensive news article from Open.online profiling a landmark study led by Fabio Giglietto. The article discusses how Meta's algorithmic 'political content reduction' policy resulted in an asymmetric penalty: official, mainstream political figures lost significant reach on Facebook, whereas extremist and hyperpartisan networks experienced minimal impact and effectively grew their overall visibility.
